label: prf:topological-mass
title: Proof of Topological Decomposition of Mass
html:
The proof proceeds in four steps: decomposition of the mass integral using the descent involution, identification of the descended term with the unknot-core holonomy, localisation of the transient terms to exceptional divisors, and evaluation via the quantum dilogarithm.

By (eigenspace decomposition of the mass integrand), the descent involution \hat{\tau}_n produces an orthogonal Killing-form decomposition of the multiplicative integral

  \mathfrak{m}(\varrho)
  =
  \bigl\lVert \mathrm{MI}\!\!\int_\Sigma \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha) \bigr\rVert
  +
  \bigl\lVert \mathrm{MI}\!\!\int_\Sigma (\alpha - \hat{\tau}_n(\alpha)) \bigr\rVert.

By (descended term is the unknot-core holonomy), the first summand equals \lVert \mathrm{Hol}_{\nabla_A}(\varrho_0; \mathfrak{G}) \rVert. By (transient terms localise to exceptional divisors), the second summand decomposes as \sum_{i=1}^{N} \lVert \mathrm{MI}\!\!\int_{E_i} (\nabla_A q, L \wedge F^+) \rVert. Combining these yields

  \mathfrak{m}(\varrho)
  =
  \bigl\lVert \mathrm{Hol}_{\nabla_A}(\varrho_0; \mathfrak{G}) \bigr\rVert
  +
  \sum_{i=1}^{N}
  \bigl\lVert \mathrm{MI}\!\!\int_{E_i} (\nabla_A q, L \wedge F^+) \bigr\rVert,

which is the claimed decomposition eq:topological-mass-decomp. Each exceptional-divisor summand equals the quantum dilogarithm \Phi_q(z_i) by (quantum dilogarithm evaluation), completing the proof. \square
